text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!!)

The Tenno Sho (Spring).
The race Tamamo Cross set as her major goal for the spring.

"And its significance...
extends far beyond merely being a major race."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This is it...! This is the place I've been aiming for from the start.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The special race Dad always dreamed of.
Trainer... I... I'll...!
choice_data_list: Let's put on a great run, no matter what!
Let's definitely give it our best run!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll do it! I'm totally gonna do it!
And I'm not the only one cheering for her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross! You can do it!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: We're prayin' for your family's happiness too--!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You guys...
All of you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're... cheerin' for me...? Even in a race
packed with so many amazin' Umamusume,
you're still rootin' for me...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Of course we are!
We're all part of the Tamamo Cross cheer squad, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A cheering squad... Right, so these are fans.
They're really my fans...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I always thought the world was a cold, harsh place.
But... turns out there're folks out there who aren't like that at all..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm kinda shiverin'... But gotta focus.
It's the first big goal of the Senior year, let's do this—!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You're so popular, Tamamo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: City? You runnin' too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, fans sure are a mystery.
Cheering for someone like me who ain't cool at all compared to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No, I know how it works.
Fans look at your roots too.
It's just like fashion in that way.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have my own roots too.
So I'm not gonna lose, Tamamo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, bring it on, City! I'll show you
every single thing I've carried on my back to get here!

A monumental clash dedicated to Father.
The curtain is finally about to rise!
